Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
Having followed the thread about Riddle Phantasique I note that it's
made clear that all cards untap in the beginning of the untap-phase.
Does this mean that Vampiric Disease will make an untapped, diseased
vampire burn one blood at the beginning of the untap-phase?
There are probably several other cards for which this question is
valid as well.

Sten During

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.
As per that thread, effects which occur when a vampire untaps occur
when the vampire changes from a tapped state to an untapped one.
Untapping an untapped vampire has no effect.
